name: Tampa Toy Con
blurb: A toy and collectibles show at the Florida State Fairgrounds in Tampa, with toy displays, 150+ vendor tables and pop-culture guests.
notes: Correction on re-check (2026-10-05): the dates are July 11-12, 2026, not July 12-13 as previously recorded. No dedicated con domain exists; the organizer (Florida Toy Shows & Expos, which also runs the separately-branded 'Collectorfest' shows across Florida) manages this listing directly on Eventeny. Eventeny's own JSON-LD gives July 11-12, 2026, and the Florida State Fairgrounds' own event page (floridastatefairgrounds.com, an independent official source — the venue itself) confirms the same with an explicit 'Date & Time: July 11, 2026 ... July 12, 2026' line, consistent with admission pricing labelled 'Saturday: $15 / Sunday: $10' (July 11, 2026 is in fact a Saturday and July 12 a Sunday). The Eventeny page's own prose ('Saturday July 12th... Sunday July 13th') mislabels the weekdays (July 12, 2026 is a Sunday, not a Saturday) and is the likely source of the earlier July 12-13 mistake, which other aggregator sites (Family Friendly Tampa Bay, Fun 4 Tampa Kids) appear to have copied. Venue is the Florida State Fairgrounds (Special Events Center), 4800 US-301 N, Tampa, FL. Either way that edition is now in the past (outside the 2026-10-05+ window) and is recorded as "last"; the organizer's Eventeny hub page (87 hosted events) lists upcoming 2026-2027 'Collectorfest'-branded shows in other Florida cities but no new Tampa Toy Con date (one WebSearch result claimed a 'July 12, 2027' Tampa Toy Con date, but this is not corroborated by the Florida State Fairgrounds listing itself or by Eventeny, and is not recorded). The July 2026 edition's guests (Jack O'Halloran, Corin Nemec, Peter Raymundo, Keith Coogan) are not recorded since that edition has already ended.
